# <span id="aanchor262"></span> Densitometer Validations

Manually entered (user edit) DMF values can be validated. This is done through the Densitometer Validations screen. Users can enter a minimum and maximum value and a variance for the DMF value. When manually entering data, the user will be warned through a dialog box if the value entered for the DMF is out of the validation range conditions set in the densitometer. The variance is used to validate DMF changes for like products; exceptions are generated if a DMF change exceeds the validation variance for a given product.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Creating Validations">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Creating Validations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Creating Validations">

<div class="procedure">

To create a validation:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Densitometer**.
2.  Select a densitometer.
3.  In the Densitometer Editor, go to **Densitometer** \> **Validations**.
4.  Click **New**.
5.  Select a product from the drop-down list.
6.  Enter a minimum, maximum, and variance value for the product.
7.  Click **Save**.

Multiple validation criteria can be created on a per-product basis.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Editing Validations">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Editing Validations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Editing Validations">

<div class="procedure">

To edit validations:

1.  From the Densitometer Validations screen, click **Edit**.

2.  Edit the desired variables.

    The product cannot be changed once created.

3.  Click **Save**.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Deleting Validations">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Deleting Validations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Deleting Validations">

<div class="procedure">

To delete validations:

1.  From the Densitometer Validations screen, select the validation to be deleted.
2.  Click **Delete**.

</div>

</div>
